<script>
/* 查询期间与销量来源独立于主销量页；所有查询出口复用同一聚合结果。 */
(function (root) {
  'use strict';
  if (root.qpModel?.ready) return;

  const originalBuildRow = sqBuildRow;
  const originalRender = sqRenderQuery;
  const originalCell = sqUiCell;
  const originalCoverage = sqUiCoverage;
  const originalDetail = sqDetailOverview;
  const originalChips = sqUiFilterChips;
  const cache = new Map();
  const periodCache = new Map();
  const packetNode = document.getElementById('skuQueryHistoricalData');
  const packet = packetNode ? JSON.parse(packetNode.textContent) : { meta: {}, rows: [] };
  const historical = (packet.rows || packet.orders || packet.historicalOrders || []).filter(row => row.date < '2026-01-01')
    .map(row => ({ ...row, qpHistoricalSource: true }));
  const historicalNames = new Map();
  for (const order of historical) {
    const name = String(order.srProductName || '').trim(), previous = historicalNames.get(order.sku);
    if (name && (!previous || String(order.date || '') > previous.date)) historicalNames.set(order.sku, { name, date: String(order.date || '') });
  }
  const coverage = {
    native: { start: srData?.meta?.commonNativeStart || '2026-09-10', end: srData?.meta?.commonNativeEnd || '2026-11-08' },
    annual: { start: '2026-01-01', end: srData?.meta?.annualEnd || '2026-11-07' }
  };
  const labels = { native: '已核净销量（下界）', annual: '历史订单数量参考' };
  const sourceVersion = JSON.stringify([packet.meta?.source?.sha256 || '', packet.meta?.referenceKind || '', historical.length, coverage]);
  const scopeLabels = {
    business: '全部商品业务（库存历史身份＋商品订单）', active: '当前经营库存SKU（库存／在途／计划）',
    all: '全部库存历史SKU（含已清零）', nonstock: '独立站已证非库存采购'
  };

  function normalizeStore(platform, value) { return sqStoreName(platform, value).toLowerCase(); }
  function defaults() { return { ...sqUiDefaults(), salesMode: 'auto', scope: 'business' }; }
  function resolveMode(filters) {
    if (filters.salesMode === 'native' || filters.salesMode === 'annual') return filters.salesMode;
    return filters.start >= coverage.native.start && filters.end <= coverage.native.end ? 'native' : 'annual';
  }
  function datasetRows(mode) { return mode === 'annual' ? [...pcRuntime.annualOrders, ...historical] : pcRuntime.orders; }
  function productRow(order) { return srOrderInScope(order, 'business'); }
  function inScope(order, scope = 'business') {
    // 历史SKU身份已证，不代表每笔旧订单采购属性也已证。
    if (order.qpHistoricalSource && ['active', 'all'].includes(scope)) return productRow(order) && pcIsIncluded(order.sku, scope);
    return scope === 'business' ? productRow(order) : scope === 'nonstock'
      ? productRow(order) && srClass(order) === 'nonstock'
      : srOrderInScope(order, scope);
  }

  function periodCoverage(filters) {
    const mode = resolveMode(filters), source = coverage[mode], start = filters.start, end = filters.end;
    const key = JSON.stringify([sourceVersion, mode, start, end, filters.platform || '', filters.store || '', filters.scope || 'business']);
    if (periodCache.has(key)) return periodCache.get(key);
    const valid = Number.isFinite(sqDateNumber(start)) && Number.isFinite(sqDateNumber(end)) && start <= end;
    const baseStart = valid ? (start > source.start ? start : source.start) : '';
    const baseEnd = valid ? (end < source.end ? end : source.end) : '';
    const sourceOverlap = valid && baseStart <= baseEnd;
    const older = mode === 'annual' && valid ? historical.filter(row => row.date >= start && row.date <= end && sqOrderScope(row, filters) && inScope(row, filters.scope)) : [];
    const historicalStart = packet.meta?.coverageStart || packet.meta?.start || null;
    const historicalComplete = mode === 'annual' && packet.meta?.coverageComplete === true && historicalStart && start >= historicalStart;
    const complete = valid && end <= source.end && (start >= source.start || historicalComplete);
    const recordDates = older.map(row => row.date).sort();
    const hasOverlap = Boolean(sourceOverlap || recordDates.length);
    const actualStart = historicalComplete && start < source.start ? start : sourceOverlap ? baseStart : null;
    const actualEnd = sourceOverlap ? baseEnd : null;
    let note;
    if (!hasOverlap) note = '请求日期没有已接入来源覆盖，未覆盖日期不计为0';
    else if (complete) note = '请求 ' + start + '—' + end + '；' + labels[mode] + '，完整覆盖';
    else {
      const details = [];
      if (sourceOverlap) details.push('已覆盖 ' + baseStart + '—' + baseEnd);
      if (recordDates.length) details.push('另有历史记录 ' + recordDates[0] + '—' + recordDates.at(-1) + '，历史完整覆盖待核');
      else if (start < source.start) details.push(start + '—' + sqDateAdd(source.start, -1) + '未证明完整覆盖');
      if (end > source.end) details.push(sqDateAdd(source.end, 1) + '—' + end + '未覆盖');
      note = '已覆盖部分：' + details.join('；') + '。主列仅为已有来源参考小计，完整期间上界待核';
    }
    if (mode === 'annual') note += '。历史参考剔除明确取消/测试，已履约全退保留成交参考，不等于净销量或实物留存数量。';
    const result = { mode, label: labels[mode], requestedStart: start, requestedEnd: end, sourceStart: source.start, sourceEnd: source.end,
      actualStart, actualEnd, periodComplete: complete, hasOverlap, historicalRecordStart: recordDates[0] || null,
      historicalRecordEnd: recordDates.at(-1) || null, note };
    if (periodCache.size > 100) periodCache.clear();
    periodCache.set(key, result);
    return result;
  }

  function annualUnits(order) { return sqNumber(order.quantity) ? order.quantity : null; }
  function nativeUnits(order) { return sqNumber(order.netLower) ? order.netLower : sqNumber(order.net) ? order.net : null; }
  function orderCountEligible(order, mode) {
    if (order.cancelled || order.technicalTest || order.businessTest) return false;
    if (mode === 'annual') return annualUnits(order) > 0;
    const evidence = sxData.orderValidity?.entries?.[cxOrderKey(order)];
    if (typeof evidence?.validOrder === 'boolean') return evidence.validOrder;
    if (sqNumber(order.valid)) return order.valid > 0;
    return nativeUnits(order) > 0;
  }
  function amountEligible(order, mode) {
    return sqNumber(order.amount) && !order.cancelled && !order.technicalTest && !order.businessTest
      && (order.amountChartEligible === true || mode === 'annual' && order.amountChartEligible !== false);
  }

  function salesMap(filters) {
    const mode = resolveMode(filters), key = JSON.stringify([sourceVersion, mode, filters.start, filters.end, filters.platform || '',
      sqValues(filters.store).map(store => normalizeStore(filters.platform || '', store)).sort(), filters.scope || 'business']);
    if (cache.has(key)) return cache.get(key);
    const map = new Map();
    for (const order of datasetRows(mode)) {
      if (order.date < filters.start || order.date > filters.end || !sqOrderScope(order, filters) || !inScope(order, filters.scope)) continue;
      if (!map.has(order.sku)) map.set(order.sku, { lower: 0, upper: 0, lowerKnown: 0, upperKnown: true, amount: 0,
        amountKnown: 0, amountMissing: 0, orderIds: new Set(), rows: [], pending: 0 });
      const value = map.get(order.sku), lower = mode === 'annual' ? annualUnits(order) : nativeUnits(order);
      const upper = mode === 'annual' ? lower : sqNumber(order.netUpper) ? order.netUpper : !order.pending ? lower : null;
      if (sqNumber(lower)) { value.lower += lower; value.lowerKnown++; } else value.upperKnown = false;
      if (sqNumber(upper)) value.upper += upper; else value.upperKnown = false;
      if (amountEligible(order, mode)) { value.amount += order.amount; value.amountKnown++; }
      else if (lower > 0) value.amountMissing++;
      if (orderCountEligible(order, mode)) value.orderIds.add([order.platform, normalizeStore(order.platform, order.store), String(order.orderId || '').replace(/^#/, '')].join('|'));
      if (order.pending) value.pending++;
      value.rows.push(order);
    }
    if (cache.size > 50) cache.clear();
    cache.set(key, map);
    return map;
  }

  function salesFor(sku, filters) {
    const period = periodCoverage(filters), value = salesMap(filters).get(sku);
    const certifiedZero = period.mode === 'native' && period.periodComplete && sqStockBySku.get(sku)?.salesCoverage?.coverage60 === true;
    const known = value ? value.lowerKnown > 0 : certifiedZero;
    const amount = value ? value.amountKnown ? value.amount : value.amountMissing ? null : 0 : certifiedZero ? 0 : null;
    const note = [period.note, !value && !certifiedZero ? '该SKU在所选来源及渠道未见商品行，缺少本期间计量证据，保留待核' : '',
      value && value.lowerKnown < value.rows.length ? (value.rows.length - value.lowerKnown) + '行数量待核，主列保留已知数量小计' : '',
      value?.pending ? value.pending + '行状态或售后上界待核' : '', value?.amountMissing ? '商品金额仅计已知部分' : ''].filter(Boolean).join('；');
    return { units: period.hasOverlap && known ? value?.lower ?? 0 : null,
      unitsUpper: period.periodComplete && known && (value?.upperKnown ?? true) ? value?.upper ?? 0 : null,
      orders: period.hasOverlap && known ? value?.orderIds.size ?? 0 : null,
      salesAmount: period.hasOverlap ? amount : null, salesKnown: period.periodComplete && known && (!value || value.lowerKnown === value.rows.length),
      rows: value?.rows || [], note, period, pending: value?.pending || 0 };
  }

  // 补齐原查询人口快照之后接入的商品行身份，绝不由相似SKU推断归属。
  const population = new Set(sqSkuList.filter(sku => pcIsIncluded(sku, 'all')));
  for (const row of [...pcRuntime.orders, ...pcRuntime.annualOrders, ...historical]) {
    if (!productRow(row)) continue;
    population.add(row.sku);
    if (!sqChannelIdentities.has(row.sku)) sqChannelIdentities.set(row.sku, []);
    const identities = sqChannelIdentities.get(row.sku), key = row.platform + '|' + normalizeStore(row.platform, row.store);
    if (!identities.some(identity => identity.platform === row.platform && normalizeStore(row.platform, identity.store) === normalizeStore(row.platform, row.store)))
      identities.push({ key, platform: row.platform, store: row.store });
  }
  sqSkuList.splice(0, sqSkuList.length, ...[...population].sort());
  sqFacets.stores.splice(0, sqFacets.stores.length, ...sqFacet([...sqChannelIdentities.values()].flat().map(row => sqStoreName(row.platform, row.store))));

  sqSalesMap = function (filters, start = filters.start, end = filters.end) { return salesMap({ ...filters, start, end }); };
  sqSalesValue = function (sku, filters, start = filters.start, end = filters.end) {
    return salesFor(sku, { ...filters, start, end, salesMode: arguments.length > 2 ? 'native' : filters.salesMode || 'auto' });
  };
  sqBuildRow = function (sku, filters) {
    const sales = salesFor(sku, filters), classes = [...new Set(sales.rows.map(srClass))];
    const nonstock = filters.scope === 'nonstock' || classes.length > 0 && classes.every(value => value === 'nonstock');
    const buildFilters = nonstock ? { ...filters, scope: 'nonstock' } : filters;
    const row = originalBuildRow(sku, buildFilters);
    const currentName = String(row.name || '').trim();
    const name = !currentName || currentName.startsWith('产品名称待补') ? historicalNames.get(sku)?.name || row.name : row.name;
    const near = days => salesFor(sku, { ...filters, salesMode: 'native', start: sqDateAdd(coverage.native.end, 1 - days), end: coverage.native.end });
    const near30 = near(30), near60 = near(60), period = sales.period;
    return { ...row, name, units: sales.units, unitsUpper: sales.unitsUpper, orders: sales.orders, salesAmount: sales.salesAmount,
      salesKnown: sales.salesKnown, net30: near30.units, net30Upper: near30.unitsUpper, net60: near60.units, net60Upper: near60.unitsUpper,
      salesMode: period.mode, salesBasis: period.label, periodStart: filters.start, periodEnd: filters.end,
      actualCoverageStart: period.actualStart, actualCoverageEnd: period.actualEnd, periodComplete: period.periodComplete,
      historicalRecordStart: period.historicalRecordStart, historicalRecordEnd: period.historicalRecordEnd,
      nearSalesEnd: coverage.native.end, nearSalesBasis: labels.native, coverageNote: sales.note, _salesRows: sales.rows, _period: period,
      businessClasses: classes, active: pcIsIncluded(sku, 'active') || population.has(sku),
      ...(nonstock ? { available: null, reserved: null, transit: null, stockWarehouses: [], stockDate: '非库存采购，不适用库存余额',
        ageText: '不适用：非库存采购', ageSort: null, ageSets: null, operatingMargin: null, realMargin: null, _reference: null,
        profitStatus: '非库存业务，不借库存利润参考', profitBasis: 'missing', sourceNote: '本期所选商品行为非库存业务；未套用库存售价和利润' } : {}) };
  };

  sqMatches = function (row, filters) {
    const scope = filters.scope || 'business';
    if (scope === 'business' ? !(pcIsIncluded(row.sku, 'all') || population.has(row.sku)) : !pcIsIncluded(row.sku, scope)) return false;
    const query = String(filters.search || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (query && ![row.sku, row.name, row.platform, row.store, row.warehouse].some(value => String(value || '').toLowerCase().includes(query))) return false;
    if (filters.productType && row.productType !== filters.productType) return false;
    if ((sqValues(filters.platform).length || sqValues(filters.store).length)
      && !(sqChannelIdentities.get(row.sku) || []).some(identity => sqOrderScope(identity, filters))) return false;
    const warehouses = sqValues(filters.warehouse).map(sqWarehouseCode);
    if (warehouses.length && !warehouses.some(value => row.stockWarehouses.includes(value))) return false;
    if (filters.ageBand && !(sqNumber(sqStockBySku.get(row.sku)?.ageBands?.[filters.ageBand]) && sqStockBySku.get(row.sku).ageBands[filters.ageBand] > 0)) return false;
    if (sqLimit(filters.salesMin) != null && (!sqNumber(row.units) || row.units < Number(filters.salesMin))) return false;
    if (sqLimit(filters.salesMax) != null && (!row.periodComplete || !sqNumber(row.unitsUpper) || row.unitsUpper > Number(filters.salesMax))) return false;
    const margin = filters.marginBasis === 'real' ? row.realMargin : row.operatingMargin;
    if (filters.evidenceMode === 'missing' && sqNumber(margin)) return false;
    if (!sqInRange(margin, sqLimit(filters.marginMin) == null ? null : Number(filters.marginMin) / 100, sqLimit(filters.marginMax) == null ? null : Number(filters.marginMax) / 100)) return false;
    return sqInRange(row.available, filters.availableMin, filters.availableMax) && sqInRange(row.displayPrice, filters.priceMin, filters.priceMax);
  };

  function getRows(filters, sort = { key: 'units', direction: 'desc' }) {
    const configured = { ...defaults(), ...filters };
    if (!Number.isFinite(sqDateNumber(configured.start)) || !Number.isFinite(sqDateNumber(configured.end)) || configured.start > configured.end) return [];
    return sqSortRows(sqSkuList.map(sku => sqBuildRow(sku, configured)).filter(row => sqMatches(row, configured)), sort);
  }
  sqExportRows = getRows;
  sqQuery = function (filters, sort, page = 0, pageSize = 50) {
    const configured = { ...defaults(), ...filters }, rows = getRows(configured, sort), period = periodCoverage(configured);
    sqActiveRows = rows;
    const known = rows.filter(row => sqNumber(row.units)), amount = rows.filter(row => sqNumber(row.salesAmount));
    return { rows: rows.slice(page * pageSize, (page + 1) * pageSize), total: rows.length, facets: sqFacets,
      summary: { skuCount: rows.length, units: known.length ? known.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.units, 0) : null,
        unitsKnownCount: known.length, salesAmount: amount.length ? amount.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.salesAmount, 0) : null,
        salesAmountKnownCount: amount.length, operatingMarginKnownCount: rows.filter(row => sqNumber(row.operatingMargin)).length,
        profitMissingCount: rows.filter(row => !sqNumber(row.operatingMargin)).length,
        partialCount: rows.filter(row => !row.periodComplete && sqNumber(row.units)).length },
      meta: { salesCutoff: coverage.native.end, salesCoverage: period.note, salesBasis: period.label, period,
        productTypeRule: '库存商品类型沿已核分类，非库存属性按订单商品行区分；不由低销量推断商品类型。',
        message: '所选期间、筛选、排序、汇总、CSV及详情采用同一销售口径。近30/60天独立采用原生净量；库存和利润为独立来源快照及参考。' } };
  };

  sqUiColumnLabels.units = '所选期间销量';
  sqUiFieldLabels.salesMode = '销售口径';
  if (!sqUiState.visibleColumns.includes('units')) sqUiState.visibleColumns.splice(1, 0, 'units');
  Object.assign(sqUiState.draft, { salesMode: 'auto', scope: 'business' });
  Object.assign(sqUiState.filters, { salesMode: 'auto', scope: 'business' });
  sqUiRecentRange = days => ({ start: sqDateAdd(coverage.native.end, 1 - days), end: coverage.native.end });
  sqUiCell = function (column, row) {
    if (column === 'units') {
      const history = Boolean(row.historicalRecordStart), missing = !sqNumber(row.units);
      const shortNote = !row.periodComplete ? '已覆盖部分 · ' + (history ? '历史记录小计，完整覆盖待核'
        : row.actualCoverageStart ? '实际 ' + row.actualCoverageStart + '—' + row.actualCoverageEnd : '未覆盖')
        : missing ? '本期未见计量证据' : !sqNumber(row.unitsUpper) ? '数量上界待核' : '';
      return '<span class="sq-cell-number">' + (missing ? '待核' : (row.salesMode === 'native' && !sqNumber(row.unitsUpper) ? '≥' : '') + sqUiQty(row.units))
        + (row.salesMode === 'native' && sqNumber(row.unitsUpper) && row.units !== row.unitsUpper ? '—' + sqUiQty(row.unitsUpper) : '')
        + '</span>' + sqUiSmall(row.salesBasis) + sqUiSmall('请求 ' + row.periodStart + '—' + row.periodEnd)
        + (shortNote ? '<small class="qp-partial" title="' + sqUiEsc(row.coverageNote) + '">' + sqUiEsc(shortNote) + '</small>' : '')
        + sqUiSmall((row.salesMode === 'annual' ? '参考订单 ' : '有效订单 ') + sqUiQty(row.orders));
    }
    if (column === 'nearSales') return originalCell(column, row) + sqUiSmall('原生净量 · 截至' + row.nearSalesEnd);
    return originalCell(column, row);
  };
  sqUiSummary = function (result) {
    const summary = result.summary, period = result.meta.period;
    return '<div class="sq-summary"><span><b>' + sqUiQty(result.total) + '</b>款SKU</span><span><b>' + sqUiQty(summary.units)
      + '</b>' + sqUiEsc(period.label) + (period.periodComplete ? '' : ' · 已覆盖部分')
      + ' · ' + summary.unitsKnownCount + '款有据（按源商品单位）</span><span><b>' + sqUiMoney(summary.salesAmount)
      + '</b>商品销售额' + (period.periodComplete ? '' : '（来源内小计）') + '</span><span><b>' + summary.operatingMarginKnownCount
      + '</b>款利润有参考</span></div>';
  };
  sqUiCoverage = function (result) {
    return originalCoverage(result);
  };
  sqUiFilterChips = function () {
    let html = originalChips();
    if (sqUiState.filters.scope !== 'active') html = html.replace('含历史零库存身份', sqUiEsc(scopeLabels[sqUiState.filters.scope] || sqUiState.filters.scope));
    return html + '<p class="qp-applied-mode">已应用销售口径：' + sqUiEsc(labels[resolveMode(sqUiState.filters)])
      + (sqUiState.filters.salesMode === 'auto' ? '（自动匹配）' : '') + '</p>';
  };

  sqOrdersHtml = function (row) {
    const annual = row.salesMode === 'annual', orders = [...row._salesRows].sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date) || String(a.orderId).localeCompare(String(b.orderId)));
    return '<p class="cx-caption qp-detail-period"><strong>' + cxEsc(row.salesBasis) + '</strong> · 请求 ' + cxEsc(row.periodStart + '—' + row.periodEnd)
      + '</p><p class="cx-note ' + (!row.periodComplete ? 'qp-partial' : '') + '">' + cxEsc(row.coverageNote)
      + '</p>' + cxTable(['美西日期', '平台／店铺', '订单／行', '店铺SKU', annual ? '历史参考数量（源单位）' : '订购／净数量下界及上界（源单位）', '商品金额USD', '状态／待核', '原始来源'], orders.map(order => [
        cxEsc(order.date), cxEsc(sqPlatformLabels[order.platform] || order.platform) + cxSmall(order.store),
        '<button class="cx-order-link" data-cx-order="' + cxEsc(cxOrderKey(order)) + '">' + cxEsc(order.orderId) + '</button>' + cxSmall(order.lineId || order.sourceRow || ''),
        cxEsc(order.shopSku || order.sku || ''), annual ? cxQty(annualUnits(order)) : cxQty(order.quantity) + ' / ' + cxRange(order.netLower, order.netUpper),
        amountEligible(order, row.salesMode) ? cxMoney(order.amount) : '金额待补／未计', cxEsc(order.status || '') + cxSmall(order.pendingReason || ''),
        cxEsc(cxSourceText(order.source || { path: order.sourcePath || order.source_path, row: order.sourceRow }))
      ])) + (!orders.length ? '<p class="cx-caption">该SKU在所选来源及渠道未见本期间商品行；不是将未覆盖日期判为零销量。</p>' : '');
  };
  sqDetailOverview = function (row) {
    return '<div class="qp-detail-period"><strong>所选期间销量：' + (sqNumber(row.units) ? cxQty(row.units) : '待核') + '</strong><span>'
      + cxEsc(row.salesBasis + ' · ' + row.periodStart + '—' + row.periodEnd) + '</span><p class="' + (!row.periodComplete ? 'qp-partial' : '')
      + '">' + cxEsc(row.coverageNote) + '</p></div>' + originalDetail(row).replace('所选期间净套', row.salesMode === 'annual' ? '所选期间历史参考数量' : '所选期间净数量');
  };

  function exportResult() {
    const filters = { ...sqUiState.filters }, rows = getRows(filters, sqUiState.sort);
    const fields = [['sku', '商品SKU'], ['name', '产品名称'], ['productTypeLabel', '商品类型'], ['categoryBasis', '分类依据'], ['salesBasis', '销售口径'],
      ['periodStart', '查询开始'], ['periodEnd', '查询结束'], ['actualCoverageStart', '已核覆盖开始'], ['actualCoverageEnd', '已核覆盖结束'],
      ['historicalRecordStart', '另接历史已见记录开始（非完整覆盖）'], ['historicalRecordEnd', '另接历史已见记录结束（非完整覆盖）'],
      ['periodComplete', '请求期间是否完整覆盖'], ['units', '所选期间销量或来源内参考小计'], ['unitsUpper', '完整期间销量上界'],
      ['orders', '本口径订单数'], ['salesAmount', '商品销售额USD'], ['coverageNote', '销量覆盖及缺失说明'],
      ['net30', '原生近30天净套下界'], ['net30Upper', '原生近30天净套上界'], ['net60', '原生近60天净套下界'], ['net60Upper', '原生近60天净套上界'],
      ['nearSalesEnd', '近30及60天原生截止'], ['available', '全国可用库存'], ['reserved', '全国预留库存'], ['transit', '全国在途库存'], ['stockDate', '库存日期'],
      ['platform', '价格利润参考平台'], ['store', '价格利润参考店铺'], ['warehouse', '利润参考仓'], ['ageText', 'YQN库龄'], ['displayPrice', '参考售价USD'],
      ['priceBasisLabel', '售价口径'], ['priceItem', '商品价USD'], ['shipping', '运费USD'], ['priceTotal', '含运总价USD'], ['priceDate', '价格日期'], ['operatingMargin', '参考运营利润率'], ['realMargin', '参考真实利润率'],
      ['profitDate', '利润样本日期'], ['profitBasis', '利润来源'], ['isEstimate', '是否含模拟'], ['profitStatus', '利润状态'], ['sourceNote', '来源说明'], ['referenceKey', '参考作用域'],
      ['storageFee', '累计仓储代表USD每套'], ['storageFeeLower', '累计仓储下界USD每套'], ['storageFeeUpper', '累计仓储上界USD每套'],
      ['storageQuantity', '仓储模拟同仓套数'], ['storageStatus', '仓储模拟状态'], ['storageScope', '仓储情景范围'], ['storageDelta', '仓储替换差额USD每套'],
      ['storageOriginalIncluded', '原模型是否已含仓储'], ['storageOriginal', '原已含仓储USD每套'],
      ['reserveOriginal', '原共用售后储备USD每套'], ['reserveAfter', '模拟共用售后储备USD每套'], ['reserveDelta', '售后储备差额USD每套'],
      ['profitOriginal', '原运营利润USD'], ['trueProfitOriginal', '原真实利润USD'], ['profitAfter', '模拟运营利润USD'], ['trueProfitAfter', '模拟真实利润USD'],
      ['storageExportDate', '库存与库龄导出日期'], ['storageAgeUpdateDates', '库龄原行更新时间']];
    const metadata = [['查询平台', filters.platform || ''], ['查询店铺', filters.store || ''], ['查询范围', scopeLabels[filters.scope]], ['利润来源模式', filters.evidenceMode]];
    cxDownloadCsv('SKU数据查询_期间口径一致_20261116.csv', [...metadata.map(item => item[0]), ...fields.map(item => item[1])],
      rows.map(row => [...metadata.map(item => item[1]), ...fields.map(([key]) => ['operatingMargin', 'realMargin'].includes(key)
        ? sqNumber(row[key]) ? sqUiPct(row[key]) : null : row[key] ?? null)]));
  }
  sqUiExport = exportResult;

  sqRenderQuery = function () {
    originalRender();
    const host = document.getElementById('sqQueryBody');
    if (!host) return;
    const secondary = host.querySelector('.sq-secondary');
    if (secondary && !host.querySelector('[data-sq-field="salesMode"]')) secondary.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',
      '<label class="sq-field qp-mode-select"><span>销售口径</span><select data-sq-field="salesMode">'
      + [['auto', '自动匹配（完整原生窗口优先）'], ['native', labels.native], ['annual', labels.annual]].map(([value, label]) =>
        '<option value="' + value + '" ' + (sqUiState.draft.salesMode === value ? 'selected' : '') + '>' + sqUiEsc(label) + '</option>').join('') + '</select></label>');
    const scope = host.querySelector('[data-sq-field="scope"]');
    if (scope) { scope.innerHTML = Object.entries(scopeLabels).map(([value, label]) => '<option value="' + value + '">' + sqUiEsc(label) + '</option>').join(''); scope.value = sqUiState.draft.scope; }
    const summary = host.querySelector('.sq-summary'), applied = sqUiState.result;
    if (summary && applied?.meta?.period) summary.insertAdjacentHTML('afterend', '<p class="qp-period-note ' + (applied.meta.period.periodComplete ? '' : 'qp-partial')
      + '"><strong>' + sqUiEsc(applied.meta.salesBasis) + '</strong> · ' + sqUiEsc(applied.meta.salesCoverage) + '</p>');
    const detailNote = host.querySelector('.sq-result-note');
    if (detailNote) detailNote.textContent = '所选期间销量、排序、筛选、汇总、导出及详情使用同一口径，数量按源商品单位（库存套装或单件商品）。部分覆盖主列显示已有来源小计，不能用于销量上限判断。近30/60天独立为原生净量。仓库仅定位库存SKU，销量按所选平台／店铺订单统计。';
    const quantityUnit = host.querySelector('.sq-secondary [data-sq-field="salesMax"]')?.closest('.sq-range')?.querySelector('.sq-unit');
    if (quantityUnit) quantityUnit.textContent = '源单位';
    const introductory = host.querySelector('.sq-intro>p');
    if (introductory) introductory.textContent = '原生净量覆盖 ' + coverage.native.start + '—' + coverage.native.end + ' · 历史参考截至 ' + coverage.annual.end;
  };

  document.addEventListener('click', event => {
    const button = event.target.closest('#sqQueryBody [data-sq-reset],#sqQueryBody [data-sq-preset],#sqQueryBody [data-sq-window]');
    if (!button) return;
    event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation(); sqUiReadDraft();
    if (button.hasAttribute('data-sq-reset')) { sqUiState.draft = defaults(); sqUiState.filters = defaults(); }
    else if (button.hasAttribute('data-sq-window')) Object.assign(sqUiState.draft, sqUiRecentRange(Number(button.dataset.sqWindow)), { salesMode: 'native' });
    else if (button.dataset.sqPreset === 'missing') { sqUiState.draft = { ...defaults(), scope: 'active', evidenceMode: 'missing' }; sqUiState.filters = { ...sqUiState.draft }; }
    else {
      Object.assign(sqUiState.draft, sqUiRecentRange(30), { scope: 'active', salesMode: 'native', productType: 'regular', salesMin: 0, salesMax: 5,
        availableMin: 1, availableMax: '', marginBasis: 'operating', marginMin: button.dataset.sqPreset === 'margin20' ? 20 : 15, marginMax: '',
        evidenceMode: sqUiState.draft.evidenceMode === 'missing' ? 'current' : sqUiState.draft.evidenceMode });
      sqUiState.filters = { ...sqUiState.draft };
    }
    sqUiState.page = 0; sqUiState.error = ''; sqRenderQuery();
  }, true);

  // 新接入的历史订单继续沿用原订单弹窗，不修改主销售页运行时。
  for (const order of historical) if (!cxAllOrderMap.has(cxOrderKey(order))) cxAllOrderMap.set(cxOrderKey(order), order);
  sqSalesCache.clear();
  root.qpModel = { ready: false, version: '20261116-query-period', coverage, packetMeta: packet.meta, resolveMode,
    periodCoverage, getRows, query: sqQuery, salesFor, normalizeStore, datasetRows, inScope, exportResult, defaults };
  root.spQueryPeriodModel = root.qpModel;
  if (cxState.view === 'query') sqRenderQuery();
  root.qpModel.ready = true;
})(window);

</script>
